description: This file defines configuration structures, enums, and functions for the PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) layer in a 5G NR (New Radio) implementation, including parameters for sequence numbers, timers, security, and data handling, along with formatters for debugging output.

methods.name: pcdp_sn_cardinality
methods.description: Calculates the number of sequence numbers based on the sequence number size.

methods.name: pdcp_window_size
methods.description: Returns the PDCP window size based on sequence number size.

methods.name: pdcp_data_header_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the PDCP data header based on sequence number size.

methods.name: pdcp_data_trailer_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the PDCP data trailer based on RB type and integrity setting.

methods.name: pdcp_make_default_srb_config
methods.description: Creates default configuration for SRB (Signaling Radio Bearer) in PDCP.

methods.name: pdcp_discard_timer_from_int
methods.description: Converts an integer to a pdcp_discard_timer enum value if valid.

methods.name: pdcp_discard_timer_to_int
methods.description: Converts a pdcp_discard_timer enum value to its integer representation.
